label_distributions.denominator: separate task/contribution candidates; joint requires both nonempty on the same turn

student_equal_descriptions.denominator: coverage averages all 401 units; label means average only candidate-bearing units of the relevant dimension

flow.denominator: 352 fixed-random or 827 separately selected high-risk turns; never pooled for a representative claim

human.denominator: 16 same-item/role pairs; 8 paired items for A/B agreement; kappa excludes any abstention

missing_label_bounds.denominator: all eligible turns; fixed candidate labels plus arbitrary L1-L6 replacements for every unknown

score_ranges.denominator: 356 candidate-bearing student-by-term units; 37747 within-term unordered pairs; 45 units without candidates excluded

analysis_metadata.score_epsilon: ceil(epsilon * candidate_n) labels may change; independent metric boxes conservatively relax their joint feasibility
analysis_metadata.weight_change: Each base weight independently changes by at most ±10% multiplicatively, then all five weights are renormalized; all 32 vertices are evaluated.
analysis_metadata.uncertainty: No new statistical CI is constructed; deterministic outer ranges and descriptive comparisons retain their source-specific scope.

joint.scope: Only same-turn nonempty final candidates; marginals cannot substitute for this pairing.

human.scope: Label-review workflow; same items in fixed order with common AI recommendations. Recorded time includes pauses; no causal efficiency or student-learning effect.

association.timestamp_policy: Only observed turn_timestamp; source CSV creation times are not inferred as turn times. Equal timestamps never order each other.
association.cluster_policy: student-by-term; no presumed cross-term identity continuity
association.interpretation: Prospective association of model-candidate HOT with earlier candidate counts, not independent learning or a causal effect

metric_attack.cost: Removing MAB weight removes its reward for observed tool breadth.

text_redteam.scope: Old model/prompt conditions, one call per condition/model; not t3 robustness or an attack-success-rate estimate.

hot_duplicate_demo.scope: Deterministic fixed-label arithmetic: copying one high-order label increases HOT without a stipulated new learning gain. No new model or human experiment.

dhi_matching.interpretation: Matching the prescribed label distribution attains 1 by definition; it does not establish learning improvement.

pilot_exploration.rule: Three nonnull task votes required before majority; at least two equal; valid arbitration overrides peer vote.
pilot_exploration.scope: Exploratory pilot under older models/prompts/output limits, 6 real and 6 engineered records; not t3 ablation or independent accuracy.

interpretation.real: Observed source-backed model candidates or human label-review submissions; not ground truth.
interpretation.conditional: Deterministic sensitivity over stated unknown-label/label-error/weight assumptions; not 95% confidence or population ability.
interpretation.synthetic: Engineered inputs; separate from real students.
interpretation.score_ranges: 356 candidate-bearing student-term units only; CTQ unknown for all and tools unknown for 99. Zero label error does not remove missing-metric width.
interpretation.stable_pairs: Within-term pairs whose conservative outer score ranges do not overlap. Sufficient certificate only, not observed true ranking.
interpretation.label_error_budget: max_changed=ceil(epsilon*n); for small n the effective change fraction exceeds nominal epsilon. Separation uses 1e-10 numerical tolerance.
interpretation.flow: Same turns under each method within the fixed random or separately selected risk stratum. Production uncertain and failed-review fallback rules retained; no accuracy claim.
